ابتكرت (form VIII)

# اِبْتَكَرْتَ (ibtakarta) /ib.ta.kar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# اِبْتَكَرْتِ (ibtakarti) /ib.ta.kar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# اِبْتَكَرَتْ (ibtakarat) /ib.ta.ka.rat/: third-perso
